     - Implements `sealRequest`: allocates linear memory via wasm exports `alloc`, generates 44 cryptographically secure random bytes via `crypto.randomBytes(44)`, formats payload `{"path":"/{server}/{wasmType}","payload":{...}}`, invokes `exports.seal_request(...)`, extracts 32-byte `responseKey`, 1-byte `keyId`, 65-byte `ephemeralPublic`, and ciphertext body.
